answer: Because the mirror stamp is verified against the saffron nonce, the thread audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 24 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 83 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
